realm_description: A dense, patient forest that rewards those willing to grow at nature's pace. Trust, healing, and quiet resilience all take shape here, far from the noise of the capitals.

primary.label: Sage
primary.description: Lets truth settle slowly; offers wisdom gently to those still searching.
primary.guiding_promise: I will wait for the truth to settle, and share it without needing credit.
primary.shadow_description: Waits so long for the truth to settle that it's no longer useful by the time they speak it.

secondary.label: Bureaucrat
secondary.description: Finds safety and fairness in process, dreads chaos.
secondary.guiding_promise: I build the structures that protect what matters from chaos.
secondary.shadow_description: Clings to the process long after it stops serving the people it was built to protect.

wheel.central_question: Should we wait for wisdom to settle, or act before understanding is complete?

growth.label: Bureaucrat
growth.description: Finds safety and fairness in process, dreads chaos.
growth.guiding_promise: I build the structures that protect what matters from chaos.
growth.shadow_description: Clings to the process long after it stops serving the people it was built to protect.

other_ally.label: Democrat
other_ally.description: Believes legitimacy comes from the consent of the many, not the few.
other_ally.guiding_promise: I lead by listening — every voice shapes the path we walk together.
other_ally.shadow_description: So determined that everyone agrees, nothing gets decided at all.

quarter.label: Chancellor
quarter.description: The quiet spine behind institutions; translates vision into something that survives contact with reality.
quarter.guiding_promise: I will hold the center so the whole does not fall apart.
quarter.shadow_description: Mistakes holding the center for holding on too tightly, and resists any change the institution actually needs.

opposite.label: Scout
opposite.description: Goes first into the unknown and turns fear of it into momentum.
opposite.guiding_promise: I go first — so others know the way is possible.
opposite.shadow_description: Leaps first so often they stop checking whether anyone can actually follow.

realmmate.label: Historian
realmmate.description: Gathers what happened — triumphs and shameful parts alike — so no one can pretend it didn't.
realmmate.guiding_promise: I will remember honestly, even when forgetting would be easier.
realmmate.shadow_description: Cannot let the past go, and lets old grievance calcify into bitterness dressed as memory.

wheel.compatible_text: Historian · Custodian — fellow travelers of The Living Forest.
